decisions.reason: The request to display the unit 3 bathroom width and bathroom-door offsets does not change the toilet drain target or routing location.
The client asks for the existing unit 3 bathroom width to be shown on the plan, but does not change its width, shower location, or fixture layout.
The dimension-label requests do not alter the unit 1 en-suite arrangement, and the unit 1 bathroom door-type change is already owned by the separate door-operation Requirement.
The same source message already has a complete MODIFY recording the change from a sliding door to a hinged door; no additional update or removal is required.
Displaying bathroom-door offsets and the unit 3 bathroom width does not change any partition-wall construction or demolition decision.
The source requests bathroom-related dimensions and a unit 1 door-type change, without changing the common corridor dimensions or narrowing method.
The bathroom dimension and door requests do not affect kitchen cabinetry configuration or placement.
